description.value: Fufú Café is a Japanese-inspired dessert café on West Broadway in Vancouver, known for its signature soufflé pancakes in both sweet and savory varieties. The menu also features Japanese-style sandos (sandwiches), espresso drinks, matcha beverages, and seasonal specialty sodas. It's a sit-down café that also offers online ordering for pickup and delivery.
